name: Question 6
problem:
Consider the system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+2y=12 \\ 4x+5y=21.\end{aligned}
$$

According to Cramer's rule, $x=$
worked_solution:
We are given the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+2y=12 \\ 4x+5y=21.\end{aligned}
$$

The determinant of the coefficient matrix is

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we construct ${D}_{x}$, we replace the first column of the coefficient matrix by the right-hand side column of the given system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{x} & =|\begin{aligned}12 & 2 \\ 21 & 5\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, according to Cramer's rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\frac{{D}_{x}}{D}=\frac{|\begin{aligned}12 & 2 \\ 21 & 5\end{aligned}|}{|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|}.\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the system of equations {3x+2y=124x+5y=21.

According to Cramer's rule, x=

a

|122215||3245|

d
|215122||3245|

|312421||3245|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We are given the system

{3x+2y=124x+5y=21.

The determinant of the coefficient matrix is D=|3245|.

Now, we construct Dx, we replace the first column of the coefficient matrix by the right-hand side column of the given system: Dx=|122215|.

Finally, according to Cramer's rule, we have

x=DxD=|122215||3245|.
